Hideko

A downloadable game for Windows and macOS

Buy Now$5.00 USD or more

Hideko is a short mystery game about nature. ☀️☁️🍃

Explore the rules of a small sandbox world to create new objects, plants and other forms of life to play with! Discover special situations and interactions to earn stars to increase your inventory-size and unlock new areas. 

Features

  • Dynamic physics system to play with 🌠
  • Find many different forms of life 🐌
  • 50 items to discover 🔎
  • 20 stars to collect ⭐
  • about 1-2 hours of playtime ⏰

Music & Sound Design by jaco "bbtombo"!
